description: ACARA Data Access Program is a collection of resources listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Curriculum, Assessment and Reporting Authority (ACARA). ACARA collects, analyses and reports statistical and related information about schools and the outcomes of schooling. School profile data tables include information starting from 2008 on each school's suburb, postcode, state, school sector (government or non-government), school type (primary, secondary, combined, or special), student profile (including socioeconomic indicators, Indigenous enrolments and other demographics), NAPLAN performance, funding, enrolment numbers, attendance rates, and staff numbers. Coverage is Australia, 2008 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-21. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
